name: Gale-Feather Fan (Phong Vũ Phiến)

arts.name: Fanning Gust (Quạt Phong Trận)
arts.rule: One sweep of the fan: a quick Wind hit that gives you 2 Wind buff stacks for 6 s.

lore: A fan of grey goose feathers; wind sects hand one to every disciple who first learns to stand in a draught.
build_use: The Gale Dancer's first weapon: a quick art that lays Wind buff stacks, so art speed starts climbing before the công pháp arts arrive.

name: Gale-Step Ring (Phong Bộ Giới)
lore: A thin ring of bent reed-iron that hums when its wearer walks fast.
build_use: Any Wind build's early ring: a little evade, stronger Wind buff stacks, and linh lực to keep the quick arts fed.

name: Slow-Hour Needle (Trì Thời Châm)

arts.name: Stitch the Hour (Phùng Thời)
arts.rule: Counts as a Slow-Hour Scripture art. A quick Wind needle that lays 1 Slowed Time for 3 s. With the foe at 3 Slowed Time, or with 3 Echoes, the needle hits 2.5 times as hard.

lore: A needle sewn with a hair from a clock-keeper's beard; those it pricks feel the hour drag.
build_use: The slow-hour builds: a cheap Slowed Time layer that counts as a suite art, and whose hit swells when Slowed Time or Echoes are stacked.

name: Cloud-Veil Robe (Vân Sa Đạo Bào)

wards.name: Cloud Veil (Vân Sa Hộ)
wards.notes: The starter robe at 0.8 of its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged

lore: A robe of woven mist-silk that lets blows slide past like cloud through fingers.
build_use: The Untouchable and Gale Dancer: Force resistance for a build that shrugs off Force, with evade and status resistance on top; light, so it leaves thần thức for treasures.

name: Swallow-Tail Pendant (Yến Vĩ Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Swallow's Poise (Yến Trì)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your basic attacks are 10 % faster and you evade 3 % more often.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W (8.5 W used)

lore: Two jade swallow-tails on a cord; swallows never stop moving, and neither does the one who wears them.
build_use: The Gale Dancer and the courier-scripture builds: a standing basic-speed and evade boost paid in linh lực, which feeds Feathers and Breath without an art slot.

name: Four-Winds Banner (Tứ Phương Phong Kỳ)

effects.name: Wind at Your Back (Thuận Phong)
effects.rule: When you evade, you gain 1 Wind buff stack for 4 s, at most 2 a pulse.
effects.from: variant-wind.md, The Gale Dancer and The Untouchable (evade feeding the Wind buff)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

reserve_arts.name: Standing Wind (Lập Phong)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your arts are 5.8 % faster and you evade 3 % more often.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 8 % reserved buys up to 8 W (8.0 W used)

lore: Four pennants, one for each quarter, that never hang limp even in a closed room.
build_use: The Gale Dancer and The Untouchable: every evade becomes a Wind buff stack, which becomes art speed, and the reserve keeps the standing evade high.

name: Windbreak Shield (Cách Phong Thuẫn)

wards.name: Windbreak Screen (Cách Phong Bình)
wards.notes: The starter shield at 1.25 times its shield and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged

lore: A round shield of lacquered paper and bamboo; it stops no blade, and arrows still go wide.
build_use: The Gale Dancer: a cast shield suits an art-speed build, and the art speed and evade on the shield itself are what the build wants.

name: Ring of Hollow Echoes (Không Hưởng Giới)
lore: A ring with nothing in its bezel; if you hold it to your ear it answers a moment late.
build_use: The Storm Front and echo builds: crit and evade count Echoes for Echo of the Dodge, and this ring's own Echo strikes again on the hits that land.

name: Nine-Gale Heron Fan (Cửu Phong Lộ Phiến)

effects.name: Phantom Dodge (Ảnh Tị)
effects.rule: Each basic attack of yours that lands counts as an evade for your arts' counters and held payloads, at most twice a pulse.
effects.payload: An evade event for your counters, Breath and Echoes
effects.from: new (variant-wind.md's evade engines, fed by basic attacks instead of being dodged at)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

arts.name: Heron Takes Wing (Lộ Khởi Phong)
arts.rule: Counts as a Gale Courier Scripture art. A quick Wind sweep that gives you 2 Wind buff stacks for 6 s. With 5 Feathers, and either Swallow Stance up or three courier arts fired in one pulse, the heron takes wing: 3.5 times as hard, burning 3 of your Wind stacks.

holder: A Wind sect elder at Core Formation or above; otherwise Lost in a cliff-top ruin where the wind never stops
lore: Nine heron wing-feathers, each taken from a bird that outflew a storm; the Gale Courier lineage lost it in a crossing.
build_use: The Gale Dancer's keystone piece: basic attacks count as evades, so Feathers, Breath and Echoes fill without being hit at, and the fan itself is the courier suite's finisher.

name: Cloud-Walker's Mantle (Đằng Vân Bào)

wards.name: Cloud-Walker's Veil (Đằng Vân Sa)
wards.notes: The starter ward at 1.2 times its payload and its reservation, so the price check is unchanged

holder: A travelling Nascent Soul cultivator, or Lost in the last waystation of a road that no longer exists
lore: Said to be the cloak of the first man to cross the sea on foot; it has never been seen to touch the ground.
build_use: The Untouchable: Cold Feet and Beneath Notice make fleeing a higher-realm foe likely, and the veil's evade keeps the rest of the fight from starting.

name: Slipstream Ring (Phong Lưu Giới)
lore: A ring of braided copper wire that hums when an art is thrown; the air behind it is never quite still.
build_use: The cooldown-floor build's second real ring: faster arts that cost less, and a little linh lực back on every hit, so a build that pays per hit stays fed.
notes: Answers: cooldown-floor: a Wind ring above grade 1 with art speed and cost reduction; also lowers art cost and feeds linh lực per hit

name: Scatter-Gale Pendant (Tán Phong Bội)

effects.name: Scatter Gale (Tán Phong)
effects.rule: When you evade, you cleanse your own debuff stacks, at most 2 batches every 6 s.
effects.payload: Cleanse of your own debuff stacks, 2 batches per 6 s
effects.from: variant-wind.md, The Evade Dancer (the lost Scatter Gale)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12, patch 2026-11-13)

lore: A jade pendant split along its length; when the wind takes it, whatever clung to you is blown off.
build_use: The Evade Dancer: every dodge sweeps your own stacks away, so evading doubles as the build's cleanse, on top of evade, status resistance and linh lực regeneration.
notes: Answers: evade-dancer: an evade-cleanse treasure (the lost Scatter Gale), 2 batches per 6 s
